title: L¹_loc convergence of sets transfers integrals and local volumes
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^{m+1}, and let F_k ⊆ E (k ∈ ℕ) and F₀ ⊆ E be Borel sets with L^{m+1}((F_k Δ F₀) ∩ B_R(0)) → 0 as k → ∞ for every R ∈ ℝ. Then: (a) ∫_{F_k} f dL^{m+1} → ∫_{F₀} f dL^{m+1} for every continuous compactly supported f : E → ℝ; (b) L^{m+1}(F_k ∩ B_s(0)) → L^{m+1}(F₀ ∩ B_s(0)) for every s ∈ ℝ; (c) L^{m+1}(B_s(0) ∖ F_k) → L^{m+1}(B_s(0) ∖ F₀) for every s ∈ ℝ (convergence in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (F₀ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (Fs k)) → MeasurableSet F₀ → (∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (Fs k) F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → (∀ f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ z in Fs k, f z) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z in F₀, f z))) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => volume (Fs k ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s)) atTop (𝓝 (volume (F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s)))) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => volume (ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s \ Fs k)) atTop (𝓝 (volume (ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s \ F₀)))
